# OlympiaDAO — Sustainable Governance for Ethereum Classic

## About

Olympia is a staged governance and funding system for Ethereum Classic (ETC). It redirects EIP-1559 basefee revenue into an on-chain Treasury, then builds governance layers to allocate funds transparently. The system is non-inflationary — no new coins are minted.

## Key Components

- Treasury (ECIP-1112): Protocol-controlled vault receiving basefee revenue
- Governor (ECIP-1113): On-chain governance with soulbound NFT membership
- ECFP Registry (ECIP-1114): Ethereum Classic Funding Proposal submission and tracking
- Sanctions Oracle (ECIP-1119): OFAC compliance constraint
- Futarchy Markets (ECIP-1117): Prediction market-based governance decisions

## Governance Stages

1. Treasury accumulation (EIP-1559 basefee)
2. CoreDAO governance (proposals, voting, execution)
3. Futarchy markets (prediction-based decisions)

## Network

- Mordor Testnet (Chain ID 63) — Demo v0.1
- Activation: Block 15,800,850
